class.name: RosTfBroadcaster3D
class.brief_description: A spatial node that automatically broadcasts its 3D transform to a ROS 2 TF2 frame.
class.description: [RosTfBroadcaster3D] is a helper node that simplifies the process of sending coordinate transforms to ROS 2. As a descendant of [Node3D], it automatically tracks its local transformation relative to a parent and broadcasts it as a ROS 2 TF transform. This node is particularly useful for modeling robot joints, sensors, or objects in a simulation, as it handles the math and frequency management automatically.

method.name: publish_transform
method.description: Forces an immediate publication of the node's current transform to the ROS 2 TF2 tree.

members.member: The name of this coordinate frame in the ROS 2 transformation tree.
The name of the parent coordinate frame in the ROS 2 transformation tree.
A path to another [RosTfBroadcaster3D] node. If set, [member parent_frame_id] will be automatically updated to match the [member frame_id] of the targeted node.
The frequency (in Hz) at which the transform is published to ROS 2. Higher values provide smoother motion tracking but consume more bandwidth.
If [code]true[/code], the transform is sent as a static transform. Static transforms are typically used for fixed attachments between objects that do not change over time.
